INTRODUCTION
DEFRA
 have implemented a new 
&lt;project name&gt;. 
Th
is 
will replace 
&lt;overview of project&gt;
. 
This 
 low
 level design (
LLD
)
 
details the 
&lt;project component&gt;
 from an infrastructure perspective.
Purpose of the 
Low Level
 Solution Design Document
The 
Low Level
 Solution Design Document tracks the necessary information required to effectively define architecture and system design 
in order to
 give the implementation team guidance on 
the component 
architecture of the system to be built. 
It describes a detailed configuration of each solution component and is created after the 
high level
 designs to inform downstream build and test activities. 
Design documents are incrementally and iteratively produced during the solution development life cycle based on the 
particular circumstances
 of the project and the methodology used for developing the system. Its intended audience is the project manager project team and implementation teams

This design differs from the

 design as described below:
